name: Jakarta Masters 2023

venue.name: Hublife Mall
venue.address: Jl. Tanjung Duren Timur No.2, RT.12/RW.5, Tj. Duren Sel., Kec. Grogol petamburan, Kota Jakarta Barat, Daerah Khusus Ibuk

information: This is the first speedcubing competition in Jakarta in 2023 featuring rare events, such as 6x6x6, 7x7x7, Megaminx, Square-1, and Clock. We use the word "masters" to highlight advanced skills in events like 6x6, 7x7, megaminx, and square-1, as it's been quite some time since these events are competed in Jakarta. We will also present awards to the winners of 'Kids Category' for competitors under the age of 12 (3x3 Only).
